_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-04 (Steam capture 20260804154408 (art), 154554-154610 (loadout)). The page leads with the in-game class name, which is the title the loadout screen shows; the model designation rides underneath. One page covers both faction variants; both models were captured, NATO on 2026-08-04 15:43-15:48 and Pax Armata at 16:59-17:00. TBD is deliberate everywhere: a slot screen names every option in its row but describes only the highlighted one, so most options are named and not yet described. Class name confirmed against the loadout root screen (capture 20260804170512).
name: Infantry Fighting Vehicle

options.name: High Explosive
options.title: High Explosive Shell
options.description: A shell designed to combat infantry and non-armored vehicles. Less effective against armored targets.

options.name: Anti-Personnel
options.description: A shell designed to target infantry at short to medium ranges. Ineffective against armor.
options.title: Anti-Personnel Shell

options.name: Armor-Piercing
options.description: A shell designed to target heavy armor. Less effective against infantry due to the absence of an explosive charge.
options.title: Armor-Piercing Shell

options.name: Aim-Guided
options.title: Aim-Guided Missile
options.description: An effective anti-vehicle missile that can be guided to the target via a weapon's crosshairs.

options.name: Lock-Guided
options.description: An effective anti-vehicle missile. Requires lock-on before launch, after which the missile will guide itself to the target unless intercepted by countermeasures. Capable of faster and longer range lock-ons for targets that have been marked with the Laser Designator or Tracer Dart.
options.title: Lock-Guided Missile

options.name: Light Rockets
options.description: Multi-purpose unguided rockets effective against almost all targets.

options.name: Smoke Generator
options.description: Emits smoke continuously to obscure the vehicle. Can be laid down while driving to create a smoke wall. Blocks ability to spot targets and clears spotted markers from all infantry inside the smoke radius.

options.name: Thermal-Blocking
options.description: Discharges a cloud of thermal smoke that obscures the vehicle. Disrupts the guidance systems of incoming lock-on missiles, blocks spotting, and deals moderate damage to enemy infantry inside the smoke radius.
options.title: Thermal-Blocking Smoke

options.name: Emergency Repair
options.description: Repairs damaged vehicles. Can only be activated when the vehicle is in a low-health state.

options.name: Threat Detector
options.title: Proximity Threat Detector
options.description: Detects nearby enemy soldiers and vehicles and shows them on the minimap for a short duration.

options.name: Counter-Fire Radar
options.description: Passively spots sources of incoming damage. Can be activated to extend spotting and designate spotted enemy vehicles.

options.name: Mobile Command
options.description: Increases the rate of capture when the vehicle is inside an objective's capture area.
options.title: Mobile Command Station

options.name: Field Maintenance
options.description: Enables faster vehicle health recovery after taking damage. Will also gain ammo faster.

options.name: Targeting Jammer
options.description: Slows the enemy's ability to acquire lock-on, clears the vehicle's spotted marker sooner, and reduces its heat signature in thermal imaging.

options.name: Emergency Countermeasures
options.description: Substantially improves the recharge rate of countermeasures when at low health.

options.name: Systems Upgrade
options.description: Faster cooldowns enabled on equipment in slot 1 and increased range and duration on equipment in slot 2.

options.name: Light Machine Gun
options.description: A machine gun ideal for combatting enemy infantry at medium-range. Less effective against lightly armored vehicles.

options.name: Heavy Machine Gun
options.description: A machine gun ideal for combatting unarmored vehicles and infantry at long range.

options.name: Grenade Launcher
options.description: An automatic grenade launcher, effective at targeting infantry and unarmored targets at close range.

options.name: Smoke Wall
options.title: Smoke Wall Launcher
options.description: Fires multiple smoke projectiles that detonate to form a smoke wall and obscure the vehicle. Blocks ability to spot targets and clears spotted markers from all infantry inside the smoke radius.

options.name: Countermeasures
options.description: Detects mines and C-4 explosives enabling the operator to activate countermeasures to destroy them.

options.name: Target Designator
options.description: The designator allows users to mark both vehicles and locations. Designated targets can be locked-on from further away and lose below-radar protection.
